start_here: Say to your AI: "Show me the Look screen: how Trillion looks and feels on my screens." It reads the row of tool:look and tells you the three sections the screen host draws: Screen look, Panes and Feel.
no_lists_because: It reads no list and runs nothing: the screen host draws its fixed layout, and each part keeps its own choice in your account's records.
instructions: 1. Open the Look screen at /work/api/screens/look in the app (the screen host draws it), or ask your AI to read the row with tools:list {tool: "tool:look"}.
2. Read the layout: a title, a lead and three sections, each lending a shared part (screen-look, pane-sizes, feel).
3. Make your choices in the parts themselves: choose a look, drag a pane's edge to feel the snap, press play on a feel to try it; each change appears right away and is kept in your account's records.
